findings.evidence: Body: "108.1[Repealed, SOR/2018-43, s. 4]"; the record summary itself says the section "has been repealed and contains no active requirements".

findings.proposed: Pedals (clutch/brake pedal interlock) plus a transmission-related tag if the taxonomy allows; drop Brakes/Steering column
findings.evidence: Body covers automatic/manual transmission control positions, engine start inhibit, park-position brake interlock and clutch interlock; no brake or steering-column hardware requirements.
UN R121 covers location and identification of hand controls, tell-tales and indicators; s. 102 sets transmission control sequence/display/start-interlock requirements (FMVSS 102 analogue).

findings.proposed: none (wipers/washers are not covered by a UN Regulation); remove R45
findings.evidence: UN R45 is "Headlamp cleaners"; s. 104 regulates windshield wiping and washing systems (SAE J903a/J942).

findings.current: Passenger car, Light truck, Heavy truck, Bus
findings.evidence: Body: "every multi-purpose passenger vehicle, truck and bus shall conform to ... TSD 105"; passenger cars are covered by s. 135 (TSD 135).

findings.proposed: MVSR s. 108 — Lamps, Reflective Devices and Associated Equipment (TSD 108)
findings.evidence: Body: "108(1) Every passenger car, multi-purpose passenger vehicle, truck, trailer and bus shall conform to ... TSD 108, Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment"; three-wheeled vehicles are only subsec. (2).

findings.proposed: Lead with subsec. (1): passenger cars, MPVs, trucks, trailers and buses must conform to TSD 108; then three-wheeled vehicle additions
findings.evidence: Summary omits the main requirement of s. 108(1).
Tags are AI-assigned from a body that contains no regulatory content; nothing supports "Vehicle identification".

findings.current: MVSR s. 111 — Passenger Cars and Three-wheeled Vehicles
findings.proposed: MVSR s. 111 — Rearward Field of View / Mirrors
findings.evidence: Body also contains "(13) Every motorcycle shall have, mounted on each side ... mirror" and "(16) Every school bus shall have the following two outside mirror systems".

findings.proposed: Passenger car, Motorcycle, Bus (school bus), Light truck
findings.evidence: Body subsecs. (13) motorcycle mirrors and (16)-(25) school bus System A/B mirrors; summary also limited to passenger cars and three-wheeled vehicles.
UN R11 covers door latches and hinges (the s206 record body says "Regulation No. 11 ... Door Latches and Door Retention Components"); s. 113 concerns hood latch systems.

findings.proposed: MVSR s. 114 — Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention
findings.evidence: Body: "114(1) ... shall conform to ... TSD 114, Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention"; immobilization is only subsec. (4).

findings.current: Summary covers only the immobilization system
findings.proposed: Add that subsec. (1) requires TSD 114 theft protection and rollaway prevention; immobilizer can alternatively meet ULC-S338-98, UN R97 Part III or UN R116 Part IV
findings.evidence: Body (4)(a)(i)-(iii) lists CAN/ULC-S338-98, UN R97 Part III, UN R116 Part IV.

UN R161 is "protection of motor vehicles against unauthorized use (locking system)", not accelerator controls. EUR-Lex: "UN Regulation No 161" https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX:42021X2274 ; snippet: "protection of motor vehicles against unauthorized use and the approval of the device against unauthorized use (by mean of a locking system)".
UN R148 is light-signalling devices; s. 131 covers school-bus stop signal arms and an image recording system (TSD 131 School Bus Pedestrian Safety Devices).

UN R94 is frontal-collision occupant protection; s. 201 (interior impact / head impact area) corresponds to UN R21 interior fittings. Body: "head impact area means the non-glazed surfaces of the interior of the vehicle ..."

Body: "(b) ... United Nations Regulation No. 11, Uniform Provisions Concerning the Approval of Vehicles with regard to Door Latches and Door Retention Components"; the regulation itself names R11 as the alternative, yet no equivalent is recorded.
Body 208(1)-(2) prescribes Type 1/Type 2 seat belt assemblies at each designated seating position; nothing concerns "fit".
Section is about seat belt anchorages conforming to TSD 210; the transitional rule is only subsection (4).

findings.proposed: UN R145 (i-Size/ISOFIX anchorage systems); drop R129
findings.evidence: Body regulates "lower universal anchorage system ... two straight horizontal bars" in the vehicle. UN R129 approves child restraint systems, not vehicle anchorages.
Body: low-speed-impact bumper requirements of UN R42 / 49 CFR 581 protect vehicle bodywork, not pedestrians.
Body itself cites "United Nations Regulation No. 42 — ... Front and Rear Protective Devices (Bumpers, etc.)" as one compliance route; the record lists no UN equivalent.

findings.proposed: none (no direct UN equivalent for passenger-car roof crush)
findings.evidence: Body: "shall conform to the requirements of Technical Standards Document No. 216, Roof Crush Resistance". UN R135 is the pole side impact regulation, not roof strength (R66 is bus superstructure only).

findings.proposed: UN R67 (LPG systems); R153 covers liquid-fuel/EV rear impact only
findings.evidence: Body: LPG fuel system integrity, "Test Method 301.1 — LPG Fuel System Integrity". Search: R153 "fuel system integrity and safety of electric power train in the event of a rear-end collision ... M1 <=3,500 kg and N1"; gas systems are under R67/R110.
Body: "Test Method 301.2 — CNG Fuel System Integrity". UN R110 is the CNG components/installation regulation; R153 is rear-end collision for M1/N1.

findings.proposed: none, or UN R118 (burning behaviour of materials; buses only) as partial
findings.evidence: Body: "Technical Standards Document No. 302, Flammability of Interior Materials". UN R21 covers interior fittings (head-impact energy absorption), not flammability.
Body: "Interior Trunk Release (TSD 401)". UN R11 covers door latches and hinges; it has no interior trunk-release requirement.

findings.current: "Emissions from on-road passenger cars ... as marked in Schedule III of the Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations"; vehicle_categories Passenger car only
findings.proposed: Scope: on-road vehicles and engines (light-duty, heavy-duty, motorcycles) under CEPA 1999; companies authorised to apply the National Emissions Mark
findings.evidence: The sibling record body: "Class I motorcycle ... heavy-duty engines are prescribed ... Class 3 vehicle". The regulation is under CEPA, not Schedule III of C.R.C. c. 1038 (a CMVSS schedule).

Regs apply to "child restraint systems, booster seats, car beds" (sibling record ca-mvsr-sor-2010-90). UN R16 covers adult seat belts/ISOFIX-type belt hardware, not child restraint systems (R44/R129).

findings.current: "Compliance covers seats, belt assemblies, retractors, buckles, anchorages, and ISOFIX/LATCH/tether hardware"
findings.proposed: Child restraint systems, booster seats, infant/child restraints, car beds and custom restraints; vehicle anchorages and belts are in MVSR s. 209/210/210.1/210.2
findings.evidence: Regulation body definitions: "booster seat", "car bed", "custom restraint system for a disabled person". Vehicle belt/anchorage items belong to the MVSR sections; the record itself says "ensure not confused with vehicle anchorage standards".
